description: Sounds for events. A manifest names the sound files (cues) and says which cues each event plays and when; sound is on or off by the device's sound preference.

settings.soundManifest: folder name (letters, digits and hyphens; an aepm string setting cannot hold a path) holding manifest.json and the sound files, default 'sounds'
settings.defaultMuted: boolean, whether sound starts muted when the device has no recorded preference, default false

manifest.cues: map of cue name (lower case, digits, hyphens, underscores) to a relative file path ending in wav, mp3, ogg, m4a, aac or caf; no two cues share a file
manifest.events: optional map of event name to a list of steps; a step is a cue name or {cue, delayMs} with delayMs 0 to 60000

Cues.unlock.returns: void (creates and resumes the audio context; call from a tap)

Cues.setMuted.returns: void (writes the sound preference when there is one)

soundPreferenceDefault.returns: boolean (the default to give the preferences component for 'sound')
